description: Reviewed tag removals applied by data_pipeline/manual_untag_v6.py before ingesting kb_gemini_curated_v6b. Proposed by Claude against eval/rule_cards.json, approved by the user 2026-10-24 (A1, A2). A3 (ATHLEAN-X '~60%, 100 down to 40' finding) and A4 (Gao 2022 'leaning forward increases knee shear' consequence) were left tagged.

decisions.file: curated_data_v6/lunge/Biomechanical Analysis of the Anterior Lunge During 4 External-Load Conditions_curated.json
decisions.text: Maintaining an extended, upright trunk during an anterior lunge significantly increases the net joint moment impulse and biomechanical load on the knee joint.
decisions.reason: Describes the effect of the correct form (upright trunk), not a consequence of leaning forward; as a forward_trunk_lean consequence it reads in the wrong direction.

decisions.text: Enforcing strict full range of motion with chest-to-floor contact and full lockout reduces total rep capacity by approximately 60% compared to performing partial-range reps.
decisions.reason: Bundles the top lockout, which the partial_pushup card excludes (the rule only checks the bottom); near-duplicate of the window-1 finding that stays tagged.
